works.title: The Lives of the Holy Apostles
works.author: Holy Apostles Convent
works.blurb: Drawn from St. Dimitri of Rostov and the Great Synaxaristes: the full life of the First-Called, who left the Forerunner to follow Christ and preached along the Black Sea to his cross at Patras, set among all the Twelve and the Seventy.
